run:
set -e
S=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
set --
for f in "$S"/artifacts/*.tgz; do set -- "$@" --artifact "$f"; done
for f in "$S"/with/*.tgz; do [ -e "$f" ] && set -- "$@" --leave "$(basename "$f" | sed 's/@.*//')"; done
sh "$S/mgu-deploy.sh" install "$@" --skip-older --yes
sh "$S/mgu-deploy.sh" updater-sources < "$S/sources.json"
for f in "$S"/with/*.tgz; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    sh "$S/mgu-deploy.sh" install --artifact "$f" --skip-older --yes || { st=$?; [ $st -eq 2 ] || exit $st; echo "first-install: $(basename "$f") left out" >&2; }
done
coding: /usr/bin/node -e 'var fs = require(`fs`), b = null, f, why = null, nul = String.fromCharCode(0); try { b = fs.readFileSync(`/dev/shm/rawcodingdata`); } catch (e) {} if (b && b.length === 0x1030) { f = b[0x28]; why = !(f & 8) ? `invalid` : f & 6 ? `default` : null; } var manager = why && fs.readdirSync(`/proc`).some(function (p) { var a; try { a = fs.readFileSync(`/proc/` + p + `/cmdline`, `utf8`).split(nul); } catch (e) { return false; } return (a[0] === `node` || a[0].slice(-5) === `/node`) && a.slice(1).some(function (s) { return [`oap-mainapp/src/main.js`, `oap-mainapp/src/main.bundle.js`, `oap-mainapp21/src/main.js`, `oap-mainapp21/src/main.bundle.js`].some(function (m) { return s.slice(-m.length - 1) === `/` + m; }); }); }); console.log(why && !manager ? why : `ok`);'
restart: L=/var/opt/mgu-deploy/lock; B=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); if [ -e $L ] && [ $(cut -d ' ' -f 2 $L) = $B ] && kill -0 $(cut -d ' ' -f 1 $L) 2>/dev/null; then exit 3; fi; R=/var/opt/mgu-deploy/restart-requested; [ -d /var/opt/mgu-deploy ] && echo $B > $R.tmp && mv -f $R.tmp $R; /usr/bin/nsm_control --requestRestart 7 --normal 2>&1
